title: LightCarbon LCG087-D micro-suspension gravel frameset
notes: Exact page identifies current item LCG087-D rather than LCG073-D. It supplies Toray T700+T800 construction, three size-specific frame weights, 509 g fork, 47C/650B clearance, T47, UDH, integrated cockpit, storage, dropper compatibility, micro-suspension construction, geometry, ISO4210 and two-year warranty.
